scenicChapters.title: Karakoram Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 68 km this is Karakoram Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Passu → Khunjerab Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 155 km. 4693 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.

scenicChapters.title: Khunjerab Pass → Tashkurgan
scenicChapters.narrative: 253 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

karakoram-highway-chilas-tashkurgan.story: A one-way ride of 749 km, Chilas to the finish - roughly 10 h 21 in the saddle. The stops in between: Gilgit, Hunza Karimabad, Passu and Khunjerab Pass. The highest point is about 4,700 m. It crosses from Pakistan into China - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
